a1269.reason: Added a player-facing note: the printed card treated "production of hormones" as wrong, but vitamin C is a cofactor of dopamine beta-monooxygenase (noradrenaline synthesis) and of peptidylglycine alpha-amidating monooxygenase (peptide-hormone activation). Collagen remains the function whose failure causes scurvy.

a2562.reason: The body said the law has set a trade-tax Hebesatz floor of 200 percent since 2004. § 16(4) GewStG as amended by the law of 29 June 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 197) sets 280 percent from the 2027 assessment period (§ 36(5b)). The sentence now gives both figures. Spans after the edit moved with the text.
